## What problem does it solve?

Describe the need or annoyance that leads you to suggest this. E.g. "Currently there is no way to..."

## Proposed solution

Describe how you imagine it would work.

## Alternatives considered

Is there any other way of solving it that you have thought of or tried?

## Additional context

Screenshots, examples from other tools, or any detail that helps to better understand the proposal.
